soldier: Soldier head reddish yellow, the anterior end slightly darker, mandibles nearly black, pronotum pale yellowish brown with the anterior margin slightly darker. Head capsule rectangular, the lateral margins seemingly broadly undulate, the posterior margin almost straight, the posterior lateral angles broadly rounded, slightly constricted behind the middle of the head. Fontanelle minute, a depressed dot, the fontanelle area flat or slightly raised in lateral view. Eye spot indistinct. Postmentum slender and long, widest at about one-fifth from the anterior end, the sides in front of the mentum concavely undulate, in lateral view projecting slightly beyond the lower margin of the head. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 2 shortest and smallest, segment 3 stout and long. The cover over the antennal socket is crescent-shaped and slightly upturned. Labrum semicircular, the anterior margin arcuately convex. Mandibles sabre-shaped, the apices incurved, the outer margin slightly undulate at the base, with a blunt rounded small tooth behind the midpoint of the inner margin. The middle and anterior parts of the head bear numerous long setae; pronotum flat and kidney-shaped, the anterior margin broadly V-shaped, the anterior lateral angles rounded, the posterior margin slightly convex backwards with a slight median notch, the median longitudinal line very indistinct, the surface with long hairs and short down. Femora stout, tibiae slender.
